performance.samples: One warmup/seven rotated samples, no CPU affinity or noise retry; heap runs separate
performance.scope: Closed pipeline1 CPU loops. Mode0 native producer with prebuilt immutable response snapshot is a cost reference omitting admission/encoding/queues/association/business. Mode1 duplex plus synthetic peer decode-encode. Mode2 two duplex endpoints/shared executor, in-process transfer, busy owner scheduling. All process threads included in CPU, separate global allocation runs. Average ns/call and rate are not per-call tail latency, network/transport throughput, fixed-arrival/contention, peer/upstream, native Linux/72h or same-function parity acceptance. Windows CPU clock effective resolution not independently qualified.

known_limitations: Only the complete bidirectional message state machine is delivered here; automatic TCP/stdio/WebSocket adapters and independent transport peer interoperability remain required.
Negotiated remote cancellation/deadline, credential lifecycle/mTLS and four-product final acceptance remain open.
Encoding is serialized under the endpoint admission gate; owner/concurrent submit tail-latency scalability needs measurement and optimization.
Default exact-ID pending storage is several MiB per endpoint; high connection-count resource profiles/default tuning are not accepted.
Owner deadline/cancel scan and Info minimum-deadline inspection are O(live calls), bounded across Step turns; no large-window/10k-connection performance claim.
Watch-registration failure fallback is implemented safely but not forced by a dedicated Core interposition test in this stage.
Result/output/context faults, long mixed traffic, process/RSS/handle baselines, fixed-arrival tails and native Windows/Linux >=72h acceptance remain required.
Drained covers endpoint/context references; shared Server worker join and quiescing all external API/cancel callers remain the application duties before code unload.
